newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai papers call for T-bond investment funds.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai papers call for T-bond investment funds.

text.p: A Shanghai newspaper on Saturday called for the creation of treasury bond investment funds to give Chinese retail investors a greater opportunity to profit securely from the country's treasury market.

The Business News on Saturday quoted a senior manager from Shanghai Finance Securities Co. as saying the fast development of the treasury primary market during the past year made it necessary for such investment funds to be founded.
He said that the Chinese T-bond market was so large that it could not rely only on direct purchases by retail investors and on underwriters capital.
"Creating investment funds for T-bonds is simply a matter of time," he said.
China has nearly 500 billion yuan worth of outstanding treasury bills and bonds, with one third listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges.
